secrets.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather. The token previously committed in chatbot.py is exposed in git history — revoke it in @BotFather (/revoke) and use the new one.

secrets.name: GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.description: Groq API key from https://console.groq.com/keys. The key previously committed in chatbot.py is exposed in git history — create a fresh key and delete the old one.
